title.value: Memory-Aware Functional IR for Higher-Level Synthesis of Accelerators
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus on memory-aware functional Intermediate Representation (IR) for the synthesis of hardware accelerators.
title.quote: Memory-Aware Functional IR for Higher-Level Synthesis of Accelerators

extractions.description: The paper discusses a novel approach for synthesizing hardware accelerators using memory-aware functional programming principles. It introduces Shir, a multi-level Intermediate Representation (IR), that enhances the synthesis process by explicitly encoding memory operations, facilitating efficient hardware design. The paper evaluates this approach on stencil computations and matrix-matrix multiplication, demonstrating its effectiveness and competitiveness with OpenCL implementations.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The core theme of the paper is around hardware synthesis and the enhancement of FPGA programming using functional programming concepts. It focuses on performance improvements and hardware design efficiency, which are not directly aligned with climate change or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This article adopts functional programming concepts to provide a hardware-agnostic higher-level programming abstraction.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on computational hardware and performance optimization techniques, which do not directly relate to any climate or ecologically-related sustainable development categories.
primary_category.quote: The ever-changing nature of modern workloads is pushing the adoption of FPGAs (Field Programmable Gate Arrays) as the substrate of choice.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no discussion in the paper that directly relates to a sub-category of climate or ecologically-related sustainable development. The primary focus is on hardware accelerator synthesis methodologies.
primary_sub_category.quote: The viability of this approach is demonstrated on two stencil computations and by exploring the optimization space of matrix-matrix multiplication.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on hardware accelerators and functional programming does not warrant the creation of a new category related to climate or ecological sustainability.
new_primary_category.quote: The Shir compiler transforms high-level code into multiple levels of IRs for FPGA synthesis.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The content does not align with any new sub-category under climate or ecologically-related sustainable development, given its technical and performance-oriented focus on hardware synthesis.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Exposing such features at the IR level is essential for achieving high performance.
